decisions.reason: Adjustable quarter-pallet displays are a flexible, high-demand POS format that fits the firm's core corrugated display business.
Pegboard-back shelf displays serve the common hanging-goods retail need at low incremental cost to the standard display range.
The standard quarter-pallet shelf display is a staple of retail promotions and anchors the product range.
Eighth-pallet displays complement the quarter-pallet line for smaller store footprints and add little complexity.
The wooden display pallet lies outside the core paper competence, but as a newly launched range complement it is likely kept for another year.
The media-specific display targets a shrinking physical media market, but it is a cheap variant of the existing quarter-pallet design and is likely retained short term.
